text: マサキの　いえに　いくのか？

structure.jp: マサキの　いえに　いくのか？
structure.en: are you going to Bill's house?

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の before the question か asks for an explanation of what the speaker sees: 'is it that…?'. With plain か it sounds blunt and manly. いくのか = 'so you're going?'
